description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter app, displaying a list of recipe categories, filters, featured recipes, and related UI components. It manages interactions with the RecipesProvider to show filtered recipes and allows clearing filters.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays recipe categories, active filters, and a list of recipes, with UI for clearing filters and selecting cuisines.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including filters, categories, and recipes list.
